summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing ASX-required daily transaction details under its $1 billion stock repurchase program. The program authorizes periodic open-market buys of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing does not specify a share price, time frame, or other material terms, only confirming the ongoing authorization. Management stated intent to continue repurchases subject to market conditions, alternative uses of capital, and applicable laws. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The disclosure appears to be a routine compliance update, not an expanded buyback or new capital-return event. To watch: actual repurchase volumes and any subsequent increase or renewal of the authorization.
